title: STEMEd+ disciplines
description: The disciplines used across STEMEd+ Commons: STEMEd+ Jobs, Funding, Conferences, Professional Development, Awards, Digest, and STEM+ Education Research Graduate Programs. Each site builds from this file, so the disciplines have the same ids, labels, meanings, and matching words everywhere. Most disciplines mean education and education research in a field; History & Philosophy of Science, Human Dimensions, and Science & Health Communication also include those fields themselves. Each site still decides how strictly to apply them (for example, Jobs lists a job under a discipline only when it is about education in that field). The master copy is in stemedplus/stemedplus-theme.
how_to_match: A discipline matches text when 'terms' (a regular-expression alternation) matches as whole words, ignoring case, or when one of 'acronyms' matches as a whole word in capitals only (so 'per year' is not PER). In Python: re.compile(r'\b(?:' + terms + r')\b' + ''.join(r'|\b(?-i:' + a + r')\b' for a in acronyms), re.IGNORECASE).
humeta_note: humeta_disciplines lists the ANZSRC 2020 Fields of Research each discipline corresponds to, as HuMeta terms (HuMeta maps each to the OECD Fields of Science that DataCite uses, and to the ERIC Thesaurus). Version 7 follows ANZSRC in giving astronomy and space science (5101, 5109), environmental sciences (41), and computing (46) their own disciplines.
scope_note: scope 'education': the discipline means education and education research in the field. scope 'field': it also includes the field itself (research, teaching, and practice), not only education in it.
named_only_note: named_only true: only listings that name this discipline are listed under it. Listings open to every STEM+ field (general STEM education) are not, because the discipline is defined by something general STEM listings lack (for STEAM, the arts).

disciplines.label: Agriculture
disciplines.definition: Teaching, learning, and education research in agriculture and the agricultural, food, forestry, and fisheries sciences, including agricultural (ag) education, agronomy, horticulture, soil science, entomology, plant and animal sciences, and Cooperative Extension.

(?:sciences?|management|ecology)|agroecolog(?:y|ical)|aquaculture|soil sciences?|soil scientists?|entomolog(?:y|ical|ists?)|plant sciences?|plant patholog(?:y|ists?)|plant breed(?:ing|ers?)|animal sciences?|dairy sciences?|poultry sciences?|forestry|forest (?:resources|sciences?|ecology|management)|silvicultur(?:e|al)|fisheries|food sciences?|food scientists?|cooperative extension

disciplines.label: Astronomy & Space Science
disciplines.definition: Teaching, learning, and education research in astronomy, astrophysics, and the space and planetary sciences, including astronomy education research, planetarium education, and space science education.

disciplines.label: Computing
disciplines.definition: Teaching, learning, and education research in computing and the information and computing sciences, including computer science education and computing education research.

match.note: Computer engineering is also Engineering. 'Data science' is not matched, because it is often statistics (Mathematics), and 'information science' is not, because it often means library science.

disciplines.definition: Teaching, learning, and education research in the geosciences: geology, atmospheric, ocean, climate, and soil sciences, including geoscience education research (GER). disciplines.label: Engineering
disciplines.definition: Teaching, learning, and education research in engineering and technology education, including engineering education research (EER). Computing and computer science education have their own discipline, Computing.

disciplines.label: Environmental Science
disciplines.definition: Teaching, learning, and education research in the environmental sciences and environmental and sustainability education, including environmental literacy and climate change education.

match.note: 'Environmental' alone is not matched because it is too broad (for example, 'environmental health and safety'). Climate science itself is Earth Science; climate education is both.

disciplines.label: Mathematics
disciplines.definition: Teaching, learning, and education research in mathematics and statistics, including mathematics education research.

disciplines.label: Physics
disciplines.definition: Teaching, learning, and education research in physics and the physical sciences, including physics education research (PER). Astronomy and space science have their own discipline, Astronomy & Space Science.

match.note: The acronym PER matches only in capitals, so 'per year' is not Physics. The same applies to BER, CER, and GER.

disciplines.label: Science & Health Communication
disciplines.definition: Communicating science, health, and medicine with the public, as a field in its own right and in teaching: science and health communication, risk and crisis communication, climate and environmental communication, public engagement with science, and science and health journalism.

match.terms: (?:science|scientific|health|medical|risk|climate(?: change)?|environmental|health ?care|biomedical) communications?|science communicators?|health communicators?|communicating (?:science|research|health|risk|climate(?: change)?)|public (?:engagement|communication|understanding) (?:with|of|in) (?:science|research|technology|health)|science (?:and|&) society engagement|science engagement|science journalis(?:m|ts?)|health journalis(?:m|ts?)|medical journalis(?:m|ts?)|science writ(?:ing|ers?)|health literacy
match.note: Generic 'communication' or 'communications' alone is not matched; it must name science, health, risk, climate, or the like. 'Crisis communication' and 'research communications' are left out because they usually mean public relations or journal names (Biochemical and Biophysical Research Communications).

disciplines.label: STEAM: Arts+STEM
disciplines.definition: Teaching, learning, and education research that brings the arts and design together with science, technology, engineering, and mathematics: STEAM education, arts integration in STEM teaching, art and science collaborations (sci-art), and making and design learning that joins the arts with STEM.

match.note: STEAM matches in capitals only, so steam engines and steam power are not matched; lowercase steam counts only before words such as education, learning, or curriculum. 'Arts and sciences' is left out because it usually names a college or degree (College of Arts and Sciences), and 'the art and science of' is left out because it usually means craft, not the arts.
